researchDecision.method: LoBoFit-inspired four-bone local residual fitting after DAMA-inspired body anchoring
researchDecision.finding: The local-bone residual representation measurably reduced local offset roughness without creating degenerate or unweighted geometry, but it did not repair the incorrect garment region selection, silhouette, opening design or pose deformation.

blockingFindings.finding: A long narrow hanging tab remains visible in both front and back views instead of a clean underbody high-cut bridge.
Horizontal floating protrusions remain at both shoulders, while the requested three-dimensional hood is not presented as a coherent wearable hood.
The shell reads as a loose tunic with wide cylindrical sleeves rather than a fitted long-sleeve high-cut bodysuit with defined rib cuffs.
The neckline and leg-opening boundaries remain irregular and visually unfinished.
Dark speckles, streaks and seam-like surface defects remain visible across the torso, sleeves and back.
Neutral has zero BVH overlap pairs, but arms-up has 2782, arm-cross 1048, crouch 1035, sit 691 and prone 2398. The pose sheet also retains the incorrect crotch and shoulder silhouette.
Several pose renders crop the head, arms or upper body, reducing their value for complete garment review.

nextAction: Replace the primary body-region selection and underbody construction before further residual fitting. LoBoMap may remain as a bounded final refinement after the base pattern has the correct silhouette and anatomical openings.
